title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. There was black, charcoal like substance on one rim I barely rubbed out. Another glass had scratches around the entire glass about 1/2 from the top. The scratched were horizontal feathery marks around the entire glass. I really only needed 1 or 2 for a particular couple so I did not return them. Still disappointed by the quality.
